summary: The code runs and is syntactically correct with appropriate imports and reasonable error handling, but it does not implement key components of the specified simulation (disease dynamics, media effects, household/location behaviors, full policy enforcement, and several required metrics). Several metric names and validation criteria do not match the specification. Overall, functionality is a simplified subset of the requested model.

issues.description: Missing DiseaseProcess and all infection-related dynamics and metrics (cumulative_infections, peak_prevalence, effective_reproduction_number_Re).
issues.location: Global (no DiseaseProcess class or transmission logic)
issues.solution: Implement a DiseaseProcess entity with base_transmission_rate, incubation/infectious periods, mask efficacy modifiers, and interactions during contacts; track infections over time and compute Re and prevalence-derived metrics.

issues.description: Media outlets and information exposure are not implemented; no update to risk perception or trust via media.
issues.location: Global (no MediaOutlet entity or media exposure dynamics)
issues.solution: Add MediaOutlet class and daily broadcasting that updates individuals' risk_perception and trust_in_authorities according to media_effect_weight and misinformation_rate parameters.

issues.description: Household and Location entities and behaviors specified in the task are not implemented beyond minimal stubs; household norms and location-based policy enforcement are not modeled.
issues.location: NetworkGenerator and Location class; no Household class or behaviors
issues.solution: Create Household class with shared_norm_strength and stockpile; implement household influence on adoption and inventory reallocation. Expand Location to host contacts, enforce mask policies, and deny entry logic; include attendance schedules.

issues.description: Policy compliance/enforcement lacks fines and compliance costs, and policy schedule management; 'policy_costs_collected' metric is not tracked.
issues.solution: Apply fines when noncompliant under mandate with enforcement probability; accumulate 'policy_costs_collected'. Support policy_schedule and dynamic enforcement allocation per location.

issues.description: Required metrics missing or misnamed: adoption_rate_by_location_type, noncompliance_rate_under_mandate, average_mask_price (as a metric), stockout_frequency (name mismatch), time_to_target_adoption (name mismatch), policy_costs_collected.
issues.solution: Compute and return all specified metrics with names exactly as in the spec. Add adoption by location type, noncompliance rate during mandate, average_mask_price, stockout_frequency, time_to_target_adoption, and policy_costs_collected.

issues.description: Validation criteria incomplete: epidemic_control and calibration_fit are not implemented.
issues.solution: Add epidemic_control check (Re < 1.0 for 14 consecutive days) and calibration_fit (RMSE vs empirical adoption curve when provided).

issues.description: Enforcement only increases adoption probability; no explicit noncompliance detection or penalties when mandate_active.
issues.solution: Explicitly detect non-wearing under mandate and apply enforcement probability and fines; track noncompliance event counts to compute noncompliance_rate_under_mandate.

issues.description: Mask qualities and quality mix, prices by type, and inward/outward efficacy are absent.
issues.location: Retailer and Person (attributes and purchasing), Simulation (transmission interaction)
issues.solution: Introduce mask_quality types with different prices and efficacies; adjust purchasing and wearing decisions; use efficacy in disease transmission.

issues.description: Household norms and peer influence within households are not modeled; only network neighbors influence decisions.
issues.solution: Incorporate household-level norms using household_norm_weight and shared_norm_strength; blend household and network neighbor adoption signals.
Rename keys in evaluate() to exactly match the spec: time_to_target_adoption and stockout_frequency.

issues.description: Average mask price metric not returned though series is computed.
issues.solution: Compute and include 'average_mask_price' (e.g., mean of average_price_over_time or sales-weighted average if available).

issues.description: Validation criterion for adoption convergence uses mean of absolute daily diffs instead of change below 0.5 percentage points over the last 7 days as specified.
issues.solution: Compute absolute change between day -7 and last day and compare to 0.005 (0.5 percentage points), or ensure the maximum daily change over last 7 days is below the threshold.

issues.description: The 'stubborn' attribute is not used in decision-making.
issues.solution: Reduce mandate and social influence effects for stubborn individuals (e.g., cap maximum p or subtract stubborn penalty).

issues.description: Calling list(self.G.neighbors(person_id)) for each person daily is acceptable for N≈5000 but could be optimized by caching neighbor lists.
issues.solution: Precompute neighbors for all nodes once and reuse to avoid per-call graph traversal.

issues.description: sample_poisson creates a new numpy Generator per call; though not used in main loop, it could be costly if used.
issues.solution: Pass a cached numpy Generator or use numpy.random.Generator passed through components to avoid per-call SeedSequence creation.
